reviews.x: I love the ease of applying this product. The color is rich & deep. It does start to wear off before the end of my 8-hour office job, though, so I don't know if I would call that long lasting (probably holds up well for about 4-5 hours). Another plus is that it doesn't smudge, just kind of wears off.

reviews.t: Great color, spilled down my face immediately.  Bummed.
reviews.x: I know this isn't a high price point item.  But there are other drug store level brands that function pretty well.  The color was fine.  Unfortunately, this product just streamed down my face.  I was careful not to have any moisturizer to create a runway.  Regardless, it trickled down and was a disaster within 30 minutes.  Big ole bummer.  It's hard to work with that, right?

I am not sensitive at all to any make up.  I applied this on my  lids this morning and with in 20 minutes of applying this to my lid I had to wash it off.  Eye lids are slightly red and have a burning sensation.  Use with caution... extreme hold?  Extreme irritation.
The best eye shadow. Easy to Apple, stays on all day. Unlike powder shadows, no creasing.

I’ve purchased this Kiko Milano eyeshadow stick in two colors from different amazon sellers. This one #5 (rosy brown) and the #7 (golden beige). I really loved the #5 color. It’s a beautiful neutral that can be applied darker or lighter depending on your preference. It also has obvious glitter particles which I like in comparison to solely “shimmer”. It is very blendable with your finger or brush.  I did notice some differences between the two colors I purchased, but I’m not sure if it is a cons
I’ve been using Kiko products for years. Their eyeshadow stick it the best; long lasting, rich color. Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Decent product but a bit dry
reviews.x: I have purchased two of these Kiko Milano eyeshadow sticks from different amazon sellers. This #7 (Golden Beige) and the #5 (rosy brown). I found that this #7 color is a bit drier than the rosy brown and doesn’t spread as evenly. I also experienced some glitter fall out, but I think if I modify my application (use my finger instead of a brush to blend), I might be able to mitigate the fall out. Overall it’s a beautiful golden/champagne color but I’m not sure if I got an older product or if all o

I just received this in the mail today and I wanted to post a review asap. The color is the perfect tone of peach. The formula glides on smoothly and it can be applied in one sheer wash or built up for more color payoff like show. As a result it seems like this color could suit fair to medium tones. Since this is only my first wear, time will only tell how it will last through out the day but application is so easy it wouldn't be hard to touch up if needed. My only complaint is minor: I wish it

Pretty color but a little too sparkly for just every day wear. Also it doesn’t stay on very long and creases quickly. Great for a quick night out but I was looking for something a little more durable.

reviews.t: WOW! I'm throwing away ALL my other liners and shadow sticks!
reviews.x: I'm blonde, blue eyes, fair skin and almost 60. I just received my first KIKO Milano eye shadow stick in 06 Golden Brown and WOW!!!!! I read and researched a lot and this is my first lasting eye shadow and I'M NEVER GOING BACK to grocery store cosmetics! I had to stop wearing eye liners and shadows altogether because of the creasing. As I've matured, my smile lines became what started looking like scary canyons for liners and shadows to melt into and gather. I couldn't wear eye makeup anymore. N

First time I try a Kiko Milano product and I must say I am very impressed! I bought 06 Golden Brown and now I wish I had bought more for back up because it’s such an amazing eyeshadow formula and shade. It’s so easy to apply and blend because it’s so creamy. Doesn’t creases. Doesn’t flakes. Stays put all day but easy to remove with makeup wipes. Perfect for on the go and travel since it’s a good sized item. You get quite a bit of product which makes it worth it for the price especially since it’
I love this pencil. It mimics most of my Laura Mercier caviar eyesticks!
Love the black, navy and gray… I use it as an eyeshadow and eBay liner .

This brand of eye shadow crayon applies and blends SO much easier than any store brand I've tried! When you have dry skin and crepe-y eyelids many major brands of  shadow crayons feel like they are pulling on and dragging across your skin. Not so with the Kiko Milano brand. They go on VERY smoothly and you have plenty of time to blend the color. I've seen several videos comparing them to expensive brands selling for 3-4 times as much. Kiko Milano rated equal or better by every rating I've seen.
Beautiful color (Coral): a shimmery orangey red. Easy to use: glides on and stays on without fallout. I would love to see more of these eyeshadow sticks in warm tones.
Absolutely wonderful, completely black kohl. From Milano. Wears beautifully and priced very reasonably. Excellent product!!
Love, love love these.  They are very similar to my Laura Mercier Caviar Sticks but at a much more affordable price.
I washed my face 3 times and there’s still glitter all over my face. Won’t be using this too often
But very glittery, if you like glitter, this is for you, maybe the other colors are less….
So happy I found this! Goes on great! This is a fantastic find and at a very good price!
Stays on all day without primer. Tube or makeup stick hasn't broken.
The first time I opened it the color stick was broken
Love these! They last long and blend together well.

Likewise, if you have used any of the products, you can't return it either.  Very poor customer service.  How can you tell if you like a product unless you use it first? Boring color. I expected more somehow I missed that it was a total matt finish. I got the color Eyeshadow 28 Extreme... so boring. I was hoping to use it as more of a highlight and it is basically flesh color.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the eyeshadow easy to apply, gliding on smoothly and blending well.
Several reviewers praise the rich, beautiful colors and shades.
Opinions on longevity are mixed: some say it stays on all day, while others report it wears off or creases within hours.
A few reviewers report negative experiences such as the product streaming down the face or causing skin irritation.
Some reviewers note issues like dryness, glitter fallout, or being too sparkly for everyday wear.
